title: Rhydon Got Smarter by Standing Up
premise: Rhydon's brain developed after it began walking on its hind legs.
audiencePromise: Watch Rhydon's posture change free its forelegs and make it smarter, then meet its strange contradiction.
openLoop: How can Rhydon become smarter, yet remain very forgetful?
payoff: The final picture is a contradiction: a developed brain paired with a very forgetful Rhydon.
engagementQuestion: Which matters more, Rhydon's smarter brain or its forgetfulness?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and clearly. Build tension through the posture change, then pause briefly before the brain reveal. Stress "freed," "smarter," and "forgetful."

scenes.headline: STAND UP. BRAIN ON.
scenes.narration: Rhydon's brain developed after it stood on two legs.
scenes.caption: STANDING CHANGED RHYDON

scenes.headline: THE SHIFT STARTS HERE
scenes.narration: Rhydon evolves from Rhyhorn before this posture change begins.
scenes.caption: EVOLUTION COMES FIRST

scenes.headline: RH YDON RISES
scenes.narration: After evolution, Rhydon begins walking on its hind legs.
scenes.caption: HIND LEGS UP

scenes.headline: THE FORELEGS BREAK FREE
scenes.narration: Standing frees its forelegs, and the Pokédex says it gets smarter.
scenes.caption: FREED FORELEGS. SMARTER BRAIN.

scenes.headline: SMARTER, STILL FORGETFUL
scenes.narration: Yet one Pokédex entry still calls Rhydon very forgetful.
scenes.caption: A DEVELOPED BRAIN, A FORGETFUL RHYDON

scenes.headline: WHICH TRAIT WINS?
scenes.narration: Which matters more, Rhydon's smarter brain or its forgetfulness?
scenes.caption: SMARTER BRAIN OR FORGETFULNESS?
